title: DNS Proxy
description: Sends DNS traffic to a DNS proxy app's network extension.

AppBundleIdentifier.title: App bundle identifier
AppBundleIdentifier.description: The bundle identifier of the app containing the DNS proxy network extension.

DNSProxyUUID.title: DNS proxy UUID
DNSProxyUUID.description: A globally unique identifier for this DNS proxy configuration. The proxy processes DNS lookups traffic for managed apps with the same DNSProxyUUID in their app attributes. This key is required for user enrollment.

ProviderBundleIdentifier.title: Provider bundle identifier
ProviderBundleIdentifier.description: The bundle identifier of the DNS proxy network extension to use. Declaring the bundle identifier is useful for apps that contain more than one DNS proxy extension.

ProviderConfiguration.title: Provider configuration
ProviderConfiguration.description: The dictionary of vendor-specific configuration items.
